entities.name: Acireductone dioxygenase Q6AWN0
observations: The 186-aa query is an exact sequence-hash match to reviewed Drosophila melanogaster UniProt Q6AWN0; classified as acireductone dioxygenase.
Binds one Fe2+ or Ni2+ per monomer; metal occupancy determines distinct reaction products. Evidence retrieved by query_protein.

entities.name: Fe-dependent ARD reaction
observations: 1,2-dihydroxy-5-(methylsulfanyl)pent-1-en-3-one + O2 → 4-(methylsulfanyl)-2-oxobutanoate + formate + 2 H+ (Rhea:24504); Fe-containing ARD product is 2-keto-4-methylthiobutyrate, a methionine precursor.

entities.name: Ni-dependent ARD reaction
observations: 1,2-dihydroxy-5-(methylsulfanyl)pent-1-en-3-one + O2 → 3-(methylsulfanyl)propanoate + CO + formate + 2 H+ (Rhea:14161); assigned to Ni-containing ARD.

entities.name: Fe2+
observations: Iron(II) supports the Fe-ARD reaction yielding 2-keto-4-methylthiobutyrate and formate.

entities.name: Ni2+
observations: Nickel(II) supports the alternative Ni-ARD reaction yielding methylthiopropionate, carbon monoxide, and formate.

entities.name: Methionine salvage
observations: The Fe-dependent reaction yields 2-keto-4-methylthiobutyrate, an alpha-ketoacid precursor of methionine in the methionine salvage pathway; the Ni-dependent reaction is not assigned to this pathway.
